blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: greedy — Choose apparently best immediate option.
admissible — Heuristic never overestimates remaining optimal cost.

blocks.title: Define and predict
blocks.text: A heuristic is a useful estimate or rule of thumb that guides decisions when complete exploration is expensive.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: A locally cheapest edge does not necessarily lead to a globally cheapest route; evaluate candidate routes as complete paths.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Performance modelling estimates time, memory or cost under assumptions. A predicted result requires checking against real hardware and workloads.
